h1: Do I need a permit to repave or widen a driveway in Newton, MA?
title: Newton Driveway Permits: Repaving, Widening and Curb Cuts
description: Find out which driveway changes may need Engineering review, how curb-cut changes are handled, and when historic or zoning rules may apply.
short_answer: A driveway project may need City review when it changes a curb cut, site grading, or the amount of impervious surface. Newton Engineering specifically reviews driveway expansions and curb-cut modifications. A simple repaving project should be checked against the property's site conditions and any historic restrictions.

facts.text: Newton Engineering reviews site plans involving expansions of impervious area, including driveways, and modifications to curb cuts.

The state building-code driveway exemption applies only to qualifying driveways that are not more than 30 inches above adjacent grade, are not over a basement or lower story, and are not part of an accessible route.
Exterior driveway changes at properties in Newton's Local Historic Districts require a Historic District Application.

qa.q: Does Newton publish one maximum curb-cut width for every residential driveway?
qa.a: The sources reviewed for this guide do not establish one universal residential curb-cut width. Confirm the proposed opening width and location with Newton Engineering.
